phases.label: Industrial Use
phases.description: Widespread industrial use with minimal public concern. Research focused on chemistry and applications.

phases.label: Discovery
phases.description: Contamination discovered. Tennant lawsuit filed. 3M phases out PFOS. EPA begins investigation.

phases.label: Investigation
phases.description: C8 Science Panel established. Massive research surge. Health effects documented.

phases.label: Litigation
phases.description: C8 Panel links PFOA to 6 diseases. MDL established. $670M settlement reached.

phases.label: Regulation
phases.description: EPA sets health advisories, then MCLs. Stockholm Convention listing. Ongoing remediation.

key_events.label: EPA Investigation Begins
key_events.description: EPA begins investigating DuPont's handling of PFOA contamination data.

key_events.label: Tennant v. DuPont
key_events.description: Wilbur Tennant files lawsuit against DuPont for cattle deaths linked to PFOA contamination.

key_events.label: 3M PFOS Phaseout
key_events.description: 3M announces voluntary phaseout of PFOS production, signaling industry awareness.

key_events.label: $343M Class Action
key_events.description: DuPont settles class action for $343M, establishes C8 Science Panel.

key_events.label: EPA Fine $16.5M
key_events.description: EPA fines DuPont $16.5M for failing to report PFOA health risks.

key_events.label: C8 Science Panel
key_events.description: Independent C8 Science Panel begins 7-year study of 70,000 exposed residents.

key_events.label: EPA Health Advisory
key_events.description: EPA issues provisional health advisory of 400 ppt for PFOA in drinking water.

key_events.label: 6 Disease Links
key_events.description: C8 Panel confirms probable links to kidney cancer, testicular cancer, thyroid disease, ulcerative colitis, high cholesterol, pregnancy-induced hypertension.

key_events.label: MDL Established
key_events.description: Multidistrict litigation (MDL 2433) consolidates thousands of personal injury claims.

key_events.label: $670M Settlement
key_events.description: DuPont/Chemours settle ~3,500 personal injury claims for $670.7M.

key_events.label: Stockholm Convention
key_events.description: PFOA added to Stockholm Convention on Persistent Organic Pollutants.

key_events.label: EPA Health Advisory
key_events.description: EPA issues interim health advisory of 0.004 ppt for PFOA.

key_events.label: EPA MCL Finalized
key_events.description: EPA finalizes Maximum Contaminant Level of 4 ppt for PFOA in drinking water.

sentinel_reconstruction.narrative: PFOA research began in 1980 with sporadic industrial chemistry publications. For two decades, the compound remained in WATCH status - a slow burn of academic interest. The inflection came in 2002 when 3M's PFOS phaseout triggered ELEVATED status, signaling the industry knew something. By 2006, the C8 Science Panel's establishment pushed PFOA into CRITICAL - 11 years before the $670M settlement. SENTINEL would have provided corporate decision-makers with over a decade of warning to divest, reformulate, or reserve for liability.
sentinel_reconstruction.counterfactual: Had SENTINEL been active in 2002, the ELEVATED signal would have flagged PFOA for portfolio review. The 2006 CRITICAL would have triggered liability reserves and R&D pivot to alternatives. Companies monitoring the signal could have exited PFOA products 10+ years before the major settlements.
sentinel_reconstruction.key_insight: SENTINEL does not predict first lawsuits - it predicts major financial exposure. The signal transition from WATCH to ELEVATED to CRITICAL tracks the buildup of scientific evidence that eventually becomes courtroom ammunition.
